page: The OVHcloud b2-7 is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on a KVM hypervisor. Compute capacity is supplied by 2 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Haswell processor operating at 2.0 GHz, with 1 thread per core. Memory capacity totals 7.0 GB, establishing a ratio of 3.5 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisioning includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 4 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of shared L3 cache. CPU instruction extensions feature AVX, AES cryptographic acceleration, BMI2, and FMA, while later vector sets like AVX-512 are not present. The server includes 50 GB of bundled local SSD storage, contains no GPU accelerators, provides a 0 Gbps network baseline, and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations reflect the aging Haswell microarchitecture and modest core count. In compute testing, the b2-7 registered a stress-ng single-core score of 1072.92 and a multi-core score of 2156.87, placing it in the bottom quartile of evaluated cloud instances. Geekbench testing returned scores of 768.0 for single-core and 1380.0 for multi-core processing, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 2975.62. Memory throughput metrics demonstrated 178.89 GB/sec for small cached reads, falling to 25.07 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 19.33 GB/sec for write routines. Application benchmarks recorded Redis throughput at 3.11 million SET operations per second and static web transfer rates at 2.84 GB/sec.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the b2-7 delivers fully dedicated execution cores, avoiding the noisy-neighbor CPU throttling typical of burstable instances. However, the throughput-per-core remains constrained compared to modern architectures, limiting its suitability for computationally intensive pipelines or modern machine learning tasks. The configuration is best aligned with lightweight utility functions, non-critical background services, low-concurrency database testing, continuous integration build agents, and staging servers that benefit from a predictable core allocation with localized SSD storage.
description: OVHcloud b2-7 is a general-purpose virtual machine designed for entry-level computational requirements and auxiliary cloud tasks. The instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Haswell cores running at a base clock frequency of 2.0 GHz, without hardware hyperthreading. Memory is configured at 7.0 GB, granting an allocation of 3.5 GB per vCPU core, accompanied by 50 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Instruction support includes basic x86_64 extensions such as AVX, AES, and FMA, though modern vectorized suites like AVX-512 are absent. Synthetic and application benchmarks place the b2-7 in the lower performance brackets, with Geekbench single-core at 768.0 and PassMark CPU at 2975.62, reflecting its older processor architecture. Network bandwidth defaults to a 0 Gbps baseline, and no public IPv4 addresses are bundled. Consequently, this server is technically matched to low-throughput web serving, internal microservices, lightweight development environments, and batch automation jobs requiring dedicated non-burstable CPU allocations.
